Vision paste-image handler in libs/chatchat-server/chatchat/webui_pages/dialogue/dialogue.py hashes PIL Image.tobytes() with MD5 to name the stored PNG (HEAD 49165d6af4438aa7e8a1f71ce276db55f4405151 line 278: name = hashlib.md5(paste_image.image_data.tobytes()).hexdigest()+".png"). tobytes() emits only pixel/index bytes and omits dimensions, mode, palette, and transparency, so distinct P-mode images can share a filename. upload_image_file() POSTs that name to /v1/files; _get_file_id() encodes purpose/YYYY-MM-DD/filename and files() writes with open(path, "wb") with no collision check; retrieve_file_content() later FileResponse-serves the disk object into the vision model URL.
